name: gateway-googlechat
description: Outbound-only Google Chat gateway via space Incoming Webhook. send POSTs a text or card v2 message to the configured webhook URL.

credentials.name: googlechat_webhook_url
credentials.description: Google Chat Incoming Webhook URL (Space → Apps → Manage webhooks). e.g. https://chat.googleapis.com/v1/spaces/AAA/messages?key=...&token=... (env override: COS_GOOGLECHAT_WEBHOOK_URL)
